ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio; visible pixels are approximately 98% low-intensity (black/dark grey) with <2% high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the tips and lower-left edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (black) pigmentation across the macro-surface. High-intensity pixels are limited to fine, isolated speckles and distinct clusters at the distal tips; no contiguous geometric mottling or banding is present.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern. The left lobe trailing edge features 3-4 prominent sharp peaks with deep valleys, while the right lobe displays a series of smaller, more uniform serrations toward the center and a smoother curve toward the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex outer edges sweeping upward and outward to sharp, pointed terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast circular clusters (barnacle colonies) localized specifically on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detected short, horizontal high-intensity linear disruptions on the lower-left fluke quadrant and isolated vertical marks near the center of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both fluke tips; presence of multiple small white focal scars (speckling) scattered across the lower regions of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Nearly uniform Category 5 dark pigmentation across the entire ventral surface with minimal pigmentation-based identifiers other than edge markings.
